study.notes: 2016 conference abstract (no author on the record): 44 obese T2D uncontrolled on oral agents randomised to exenatide 10 ug bid or reference treatment, 26 weeks, 3T MRI and 1H MRS 45 min after a standardised meal; per arm n not given (44 total); the exenatide dose is not stated in the abstract, 0.01 mg (10 ug twice daily, the licensed dose) is entered as an assumption to confirm in the full paper; the ± values are read as SEM (HbA1c 7.5 ± 0.2 percent for 44 patients cannot be an SD), to be confirmed in the full paper (companion paper needed: Dutour 2016 Diabetes Obes Metab); weight change exenatide -5.5 ± 1.2 kg vs -0.2 ± 0.8 kg (p=0.001), baseline weight not given (BMI 36.1), so pct_weight_change empty; prespecified endpoints not named in the abstract (ectopic fat was the aim); extracted by the session (S) from the abstract, 2026-10-16

rows.notes: hepatic triglyceride content by 1H MRS (HTGC), percent change from baseline per arm, between group p=0.007 (recorded here, not used as a route); reference group increased (+12.5)
HbA1c change in percentage points per arm, p=0.29 between groups; baseline 7.5 ± 0.2 percent overall

json.design: randomised, open label, two arm, 26 weeks, single centre (France)
other_markers: epicardial adipose tissue (EAT -8.8 ± 2.1 vs -1.2 ± 1.6 percent, p=0.003)
pancreatic and myocardial triglyceride content (no difference)

rob.justification: abstract only: randomisation stated without method (D1 some concerns); open label active comparator (D2 some concerns); attrition not reported (D3 some concerns); MRI and MRS outcomes are objective (D4 low); no registration or endpoint hierarchy in the abstract (D5 some concerns); to be re rated from the full paper

doubts: SEM versus SD of the ± values
